cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's? I need one sponsor listed beside your name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Those are terms, not a sponsor. We can amend the terms. Whose proposal will you support in the meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a description. If Morgan claims you're backing him, should I correct him? Yes or no, please.

reason: Replace ambiguous list/name deletion with an explicit question about correcting Morgan claim, preserving the professional category distinction.
